questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13-Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(36, 27, 41)

(45, 36, 50)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First Number - 9 = Second number.**

**Second number + 14 = Third Number.**

For, (36, 27, 41)

⇒ First to Second: 36 - 9 = 27.

⇒ Second to Third: 27 + 14 = 41.

For, (45, 36, 50)

⇒ First to Second: 45 - 9 = 36.

⇒ Second to Third: 36 + 14 = 50.

**Option 1) (53, 44, 58)**

⇒ First to Second: 53 - 9 = 44. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 44 + 14 = 58. (Matches)

**Here, logic followed.**

**Option 2) (28, 19, 43)**

⇒ First to Second: 28 - 9 = 19. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 19 + 14 = 33.

Here, logic not followed.

**Option 3) (61, 52, 56)**

⇒ First to Second: 61 - 9 = 52. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 52 + 14 = 66. 

Here, logic not followed.

**Option 4) (74, 65, 89)**

⇒ First to Second: 74 - 9 = 65. (Matches)

⇒ Second to Third: 65 + 14 = 79.

Here, logic not followed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All pulse are rice.

All rice are wheat.

All wheat are corn.

Conclusions:

(1) All pulse are corn.

(II) Some corn are rice.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdae9f9964229b8a9d64d5f931d3e5d8e434a42e24da3e53a8be3d925ede0851.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(1) All pulse are corn → **True **(As, All pulse are rice, All rice are wheat, All wheat are corn. so, All pulse are corn holds true)

(II) Some corn are rice → **True **(As, All pulse are rice, All rice are wheat, All wheat are corn. so, Some corn are rice holds true)

Thus, Both conclusions (1) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
